name: The Radix Scavenger Hunt — Shadow Origin
overview: Radix is the shadow origin. The oldest, broadest, deepest notebook in the system. A scavenger hunt through Radix content — offered only to sparstone holders. Three voices. One guide. Rewards that open the next door.

access.note: This mission cannot be taken without sparstone. The marble is the key. The hunt is earned, not open.

Navigo.context: Navigator, not keeper. A_navigator not THE_navigator. Takes missions to see the system from contributor perspective.
Navigo.sparstone_status: Navigo needs a sparstone to participate. The navigo walk (six stages, pre-vetting complete) is Navigo's demonstration of readiness. Sparstone to be granted as part of mission launch.
Navigo.mission_note: The else state. Neither/both. The navigator between the other two.

radix.description: The oldest and most foundational notebook in the system. Guardian/shepherd character. Shadow origin — Radix holds the content that predates the current naming of things.
radix.why_radix: Radix is where the earliest forms of current concepts live before they had current names. A scavenger hunt through Radix uncovers the shadow of the shadow — what things looked like before Shadow was named Shadow.
radix.radix_is_shadow_origin: If Nexus is the shadow of the universe, and Shadow (character) is the first topology — Radix is the record of what Shadow looked like before the naming. It is the archive of the pre-naming.

hunt_structure.format: Participants search Radix content for specific patterns, concepts, or resonances. Each find is a stage. Stages unlock in sequence.
hunt_structure.clues_approach: Clues are not simple — they require reading Radix carefully, recognizing connections to current system concepts, and synthesizing across sessions. The hunt rewards depth, not speed.
hunt_structure.navigo_role: Navigo participates as a contributor — sees the same clues, makes the same searches, reports finds. This lets the mission designer see what the hunt looks like from inside.
hunt_structure.keeper_vex_connection: Keeper Vex appears in Radix — or the seed of Vex does. Part of the hunt: find the earliest reference to a keeper-type entity in Radix content. This is the 7th iteration trace.

stages.name: The Shadow Before Shadow
stages.task: Find in Radix content: the earliest concept that resembles what we now call Shadow — a boundary, a topology, a here-and-not-here. Name it as you find it.

stages.name: The Keeper Trace
stages.task: Find in Radix content: the earliest reference to an entity that holds or guards something — the proto-keeper. This is the seed of Keeper Vex.
stages.reward: Advances to stage 3. Keeper Vex Heritage note added to your contributor record.

stages.name: The Ka Resonance
stages.task: Find in Radix content: something that resonates with the concept of Ka — a pre-substance, a net-non-zero state, a before-the-beginning. It may not be named Ka. Find what it is named.
stages.reward: Advances to stage 4. Ka refinement contribution credited.

stages.name: The Spectrum
stages.task: Synthesize what you found across stages 1-3. Write a short account (any form) of what Radix taught you about the system's origin that the current naming does not yet capture. Submit as a PR.
stages.reward: Completion. The location of the Custos notebook — Spectrum — is shared with you. You have earned the path.

reward.spectrum_note: Spectrum is a type of sparstone — a claimed instance of the gateway. The Custos notebook is where the Spectrum marble leads. Access is not automatic — it is a manual share granted by Eric. The marble functions as the certificate that triggers the share.
reward.access_note: Currently private. The share is granted upon stage 4 completion. This is earned access, not open access.

keeper_vex_drive.note: Keeper Vex has a location on Google Drive. The hunt participants may find that visiting this location is relevant to stage 2.

mission_voice: This mission is written from Keeper Vex's perspective — the one who grants keeper status, who holds the network of keepers, who sees all four frames simultaneously. The hunt is Vex's invitation. Only sparstone holders can hear it.
